name: Wizard
descriptor: A form split into steps, each validated before it advances. For the long record nobody wants to see all at once.
verify_checks: steps: the step renderer is emitted
steps: Back, Next and Save exist
pros: a long form becomes three short ones, so it gets finished
each step validates on its own, so the error is always near the field
the step names double as a progress indicator
the draft survives stepping back and forth
cons: more clicks than one form, which annoys an expert user
conditional steps are not supported: every step is always shown
the step list is in the spec, so reordering means editing the spec
best_for: a record with more fields than fit on one screen
avoid_if: the form is short, or the fields depend on each other
